name: prim_spdf
description: #84's single-primitive case: He and Ne, one uncontracted primitive per l = 0..3 on each, the second atom off every axis so all Cartesian components couple. Records the converted basis and libcint's overlap.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate prim_spdf
provenance.basis:
#BASIS SET: one primitive per l = 0..3
He S
  1.3 1.0
He P
  0.9 1.0
He D
  0.7 1.0
He F
  0.55 1.0
#BASIS SET: one primitive per l = 0..3
Ne S
  2.1 1.0
Ne P
  1.4 1.0
Ne D
  1.1 1.0
Ne F
  0.8 1.0

density_recipe: hilbert: D[i][j] = 1/(i+j+1) -- symmetric positive definite, no RNG, reproducible bit-for-bit on any host
